Overview

Ahmedabad is a city in Gujarat with a population of 7,650,000. A major industrial and commercial hub in Gujarat, known for its Sabarmati Riverfront, textile industry, and Mahatma Gandhi’s ashram. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 11b growing zone supports Very hot — tropical fruits, multiple growing cycles. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
